text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Toryaaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even in sweltering heat that could wilt summer grass, horsegirls run.
It was just another day in the middle of summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*pant*...! *huff*...! *gasp*...!
Man... this consecutive heat wave... really takes a toll...!
choice_data_list: Yeah... Let's get in the shade for a bit to—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A fleeting sense of dissonance.
At first, I thought it was just the shimmering heat haze, but—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! ...T-Trainer? ...Are you okay?
You looked really unsteady just now...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: My field of vision—begins to waver.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! H-Hold on, are you all right?!
...Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Umm, our ice pack stock is... yeah, we still have some.
Towels are good too. It'll be a while until the doctor gets here, so—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Trainer, you shouldn't try to sit up yet.
Please just stay lying down.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi carried me all the way to the camp's infirmary.
My head is still spinning a bit.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
No no, please don't worry about it!
Though it feels a bit funny hearing that from someone who faints as often as I do, ehehe~

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
A doctor is coming to check on you later, just in case.
Your symptoms seem relatively mild, but it's better to be safe than sorry.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, Trainer.
Do you think you have any appetite?
choice_data_list: I think I could eat something.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
In that case, let's have a light bite while you can.
I already made some ojiya, so I'll go heat it up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I eat the ojiya Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi prepared for me.
Its appetizing aroma makes me forget I was even unwell, and my chopsticks don't stop.
choice_data_list: It's delicious... and really easy on the stomach.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
It's the Tsuyoshi Special Egg Ojiya! The aroma of chicken
sauteed in sesame oil and green onions smells pretty great, right?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I haven't been falling sick all this time for nothing!
I'm an absolute pro when it comes to rice porridge dishes~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I kind of feel like there's plenty to question about that,
but right now, eating takes priority over arguing.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
That's it, that's it! You gotta eat while you still have an appetite!
Besides, as long as you're eating well, you'll heal up way faster!
choice_data_list: It's so good, I can't help but finish it all.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪ ...Ah, let me know right away if you need anything!
I'll give you my absolute full support!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's smile brought a strangely comforting sense of relief.
Trusting her words, I decided to rest for now.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I brought a fresh damp towel for you~.
Also, the doctor said you should take it easy and rest up today just in case—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, you're already asleep.
...You must've really been worn out.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Alright, what can I do while you're resting... let's see.
Ice packs, check. Damp towel, check. Next is—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah. Out of drinks already.
Good thing we're at training camp. The one thing we have tons of is sports drinks~.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Phew. I reported back to the Academy too, so that settles things for now.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Things got pretty hectic, but I'm just glad it's nothing serious.
I totally panicked when you collapsed, though...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Still... whew. Guess we'll just wait and see for a bit.
Trainer... *yawn*. I really hope you get well soon~...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Mm? 
Ah... right, the festival was today, wasn't it...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I think... there were gonna be fireworks too...
*yawn*... You can see them... so clearly from the hill... they said.......

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, sorry to keep you waiting!
I'll be your festival escort today!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh... slowly, gently, so the goldfish don't notice me...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Hyaaa! Whoa, whoa, whoa...
Aaah, don't swim away~?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? 
It's thanks to... my nursing...?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: You'll... keep counting on me...?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I woke up, night had fallen, and it was dark outside.
However, I hesitated to sit up. That was because—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Zzz... khhh...
*mumble*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I worried that making a single sound
would wake Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi, who was fast asleep right beside me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She must have completely worn herself out doing everything she possibly could.
I wanted to let my pupil rest after nursing me so devotedly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, the distant booming of fireworks began to echo.
Come to think of it, the second half of the summer festival had a fireworks show.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... mmgh~...? ...Huh...? Am I... at the shrine...?
Where are... the fireworks...?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Wait... was that a dream...?
Haaahhh... what a letdown.
choice_data_list: Were you having a dream so good it bummed you out to wake up?
Were you having a dream so good it bummed you out to wake up?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... All summer long, I've been working so hard
to become someone you can rely on, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
And you finally, finally told me,
'I'm counting on you,' you know~!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Even if it was just a dream.
Ugh, we were even watching the fireworks together at the shrine, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi pout in frustration, I couldn't help but chuckle.
Her genuine, crystal-clear sincerity resonated warmly in my chest.
choice_data_list: If I already said it in your dream, I guess I don't need to say it again?
If I already said it in your dream, I guess I don't need to say it again?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Whuh...? ...Does that mean...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: YAAAAAAY—*cough*! *hack*! *wheeze*!
choice_data_list: Whoa, whoa, what did I just say! Deep breaths, deep breaths!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Shortly after, in the camp lodging's courtyard—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Do you think we can see them...?
choice_data_list: I'm not sure if they'll be as grand as in your dream, but...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Even if we only get the sound, that'll make for a funny story in itself—
Ah...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, we can actually see them really well!
No crowds either, so these are practically the best seats in the house!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there goes another one...♪
Aaah... isn't this lovely~...
choice_data_list: ...I'll be counting on you from now on, too.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Yes! I promise!
I'll always... always be someone you can rely on, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of us quietly spent the evening
gazing up at the dazzling blooms bursting across the distant night sky.
